title: 第5章 圣女贞德第6章 打工吧格林大哥哥
lines: 格林穿好衣服，轻咳了一声，问道：“这位小姐，大晚上的为什么要一个人待在森林里面，你不知道这是很危险的吗？”
此时的少女已经平复好了心情，
“这句应该是我说才对，我是圣火教会的圣女——贞德·耶伦苏，现在是在奉教会之命前来调查。
你为什么要独自一人在此，还有不知阁下怎么称呼。”
“在下格林，姑且算是一位旅人。
之前在森林里面迷了路，碰巧被一家猎户收留，”
贞德看着眼前的少年：身影如孤松般挺拔，肩宽腿长，却不见丝毫臃肿。
一袭黑色斗篷裹住身形，斗篷布料不知是何材质，在月光下泛着暗蓝流光，边缘处绣着银丝勾勒的云纹，风吹动时似有暗云在身后翻涌。
少年的面容十分清贵疏朗，剑眉入鬓却不显凌厉，鸦睫投下扇形阴影，略微遮挡了一下黑色的瞳孔。
如果有画家在这里的话，一定会为格林停笔，粗糙的衣物完全无法掩盖格林俊俏的面容。
此时格林眼神真挚，贞德看不出撒谎的样子。
而且圣火没有异状，说明对方是一个好人，于是她回道：
“既然如此，还请格林阁下赶紧到安全的地方吧。
抱歉，虽然这样说有些冒昧，但是以您的实力很容易在这样的夜晚里丧命，还是赶快离开更好。”
格林：“谢谢，我这就回去。”
贞德：“如果方便的话，我送您回去吧。”
格林：“不用了，谢谢。”
贞德：“没事，这是圣火教会应该做的事情，我们会尽己所能帮助每一个应该得到帮助的人。”
格林：“也就是说有不应该得到帮助的人吗？”
贞德：……
其实格林也只是想到了，然后随便提了一嘴，但是他察觉到贞德的表情有些变化。
贞德闭了一下眼，又缓缓的睁开，眼中深处的火焰仿佛愈演愈烈，她清脆而有力的声音响起：
“没错，不是每一个人都有在太阳下的权力。
对于堕落于【深渊】的无恶不作的恶人来说，我们教会所给予的就不是帮助……”
“而是审判！”
“到这里就行了，不用再送了。”
格林在小红帽的外婆家前，停下，有些汗颜的对贞德说到，这小姑娘可真认真啊，不对，小姑娘可一点也不小。
“好的，祝您晚上有个好梦，格林先生。”
“承您吉言，祝您好运，圣女。”
贞德点点头，转身离去，而格林则是松了一口气，这个圣女太认真了，以至于格林的话语都不由得正式起来，时间长了就很累。
推开门，格林看了几眼，外婆和爱丽丝的哥哥应该已经睡下了。
格林给自己倒了杯水，喝完后洗干净、放回了原位，然后进入爱丽丝给自己分的房间，沉沉睡……睡不着。
然后硬生生地翻来覆去一个多小时才睡着。
content_en:
Green put on his clothes, coughed lightly, and asked, "Miss, why do you stay alone in the forest at night? Don't you know it's very dangerous?"
At this time, the girl has calmed down.
"I should be the one to say this. I am Joan of Arc Yelensu, the saint of the Church of the Holy Fire. I am here to investigate on the orders of the church.
Why are you here alone, and I don’t know what to call you. "
"I am a traveler in Xia Green.
I lost my way in the forest before and happened to be taken in by a hunter."
Joan of Arc looked at the young man in front of her: his figure was as tall and straight as a pine tree, his shoulders were wide and his legs were long, but he was not bloated at all.
She was wrapped in a black cloak. The material of the cloak was unknown. It glowed dark blue under the moonlight, and the edges were embroidered with cloud patterns outlined in silver thread. When the wind blew, there seemed to be dark clouds billowing behind her.
The young man's face is very elegant and clear, with sword-shaped eyebrows on the temples but not sharp. The crow eyelashes cast a fan-shaped shadow, slightly blocking the black pupils.
If there was a painter here, he would definitely stop painting for Greene. The rough clothes could not hide Greene's handsome face.
Green's eyes were sincere at this time, and Joan couldn't tell that he was lying.
Moreover, there was nothing wrong with the Holy Fire, which meant that the other party was a good person, so she replied:
"In this case, please, Mr. Green, hurry to a safe place.
Sorry, although it is a bit presumptuous to say this, but with your strength, you can easily die on a night like this, so it is better to leave as soon as possible. "
Green: "Thank you, I'll go back right away."
Joan of Arc: "If it's convenient, I'll take you back."
Green: "No, thank you."
Joan of Arc: "It's okay. This is what the Holy Fire Church should do. We will do our best to help everyone who deserves help."
Green: "Does that mean there are people who don't deserve help?"
Joan of Arc:......
In fact, Green just thought of it and mentioned it casually, but he noticed some changes in Joan's expression.
Joan of Arc closed her eyes for a moment, then slowly opened them. The fire deep in her eyes seemed to become more intense, and her clear and powerful voice sounded:
“Yes, not everyone has the power under the sun.
For the evildoers who have fallen into the [Abyss] and do all kinds of evil, what our church provides is not help..."
"But a trial!"
…
…
"Just go here, there's no need to send it away anymore."
Green stopped in front of Little Red Riding Hood's grandmother's house and said to Joan of Arc with some embarrassment, this little girl is so serious, no, the little girl is not young at all.
"Okay, I wish you a good night's sleep, Mr. Green."
"I wish you good luck, saint."
Joan of Arc nodded, turned and left, while Green breathed a sigh of relief. This saint was so serious that Green couldn't help but become formal in his words, which became very tiring after a long time.
After opening the door, Green took a few glances and saw that his grandmother and Alice's brother must have fallen asleep.
Green poured himself a glass of water, washed it after drinking it, put it back in his original position, then entered the room Alice assigned him, and fell asleep... unable to sleep.
Then I tossed and turned for more than an hour before falling asleep.
title_en: Chapter 5 Joan of Arc Chapter 6 Go to work, Brother Green
